messages:
maria.g: Quick check-in on customer comms after last night's partial outage. Need owners for 72h summary, statuspage line, and RCA-sharing rules.
ryan.k: I can draft statuspage + short recurrence sentence.
samir.b: I'll write the RCA sharing guidance and a redaction checklist.
beth: Looping in @olivia.p for legal review of any customer-facing policy.
olivia.p: Will review; expect comments by tomorrow EOD.
maria.g: Requirements: one-paragraph non-technical summary for 72h, a 3-Q FAQ, and clear criteria for full vs redacted RCAs.
ryan.k: Statuspage draft (short):
"Partial disruption to hosted inference (Mar 24, 2026) — some customers experienced delays after a configuration change affecting request caching. Service restored at 03:18 UTC. A customer summary will be published within 72 hours."
maria.g: Remove implementation detail "request caching" -> "request caching behavior". Keep it high-level.
samir.b: Policy proposal: full internal RCA = internal only; enterprise customers may request deeper technical attachments under NDA/consent. Redacted customer summary = publish within 72 hours. Full timeline + mitigations = available within 7 business days as a redacted doc. Redactions: PII, internal hostnames, raw IPs, security controls.
olivia.p: Legally OK. Add explicit consent checkbox for deep technical briefings and record consent.
beth: I'll draft the consent language and opt-in for bridge calls.
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-4950 "Publish 72h customer summary" — assignee: maria.g — due: 1769750000
incident-bot: Action created: COMMS-4951 "Statuspage update" — assignee: ryan.k — due: 1769600000
maria.g: Owners recap: 72h summary: maria.g; statuspage + recurrence sentence: ryan.k; RCA policy + checklist: samir.b; consent template: beth + olivia.p. I'll post the 72h draft here for quick review.
ryan.k: I'll PR the statuspage after legal signoff and tag support.
maria.g: Reminder to keep wording consistent across support replies. End of thread.
